theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_fli_plane_ball_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (a : Euclidean N) (r : ℝ), a ∈ T.plane → 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall a r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ ball a r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
